description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class CustomFieldAPITest which tests the CustomFieldAPI class's CRUD operations and related functionalities for the CustomField entity in the OrangeHRM Pim API module.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomFieldAPI endpoints, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion of custom fields within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Tests that getCustomFieldService() returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single custom field by ID and verifies the normalized result.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the getOne API call.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field and verifies the result.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeExtraData
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field with changed extra data and verifies the result.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeType
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field's type when it is in use, expecting a bad request.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the update API call.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a custom field that exists.

methods.name: testDeleteNoInUse
methods.description: Tests deleting a custom field that is not in use.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the delete API call.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new custom field and verifies the result.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the create API call.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple custom fields and verifies the normalized list.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the getAll API call.
